evals.prompt: Model the checkout session state for me - it can be idle, loading, done with a receipt, or failed with an error.
evals.expected_output: A discriminated union with one variant per state, readonly fields, exhaustive switch with assertNever - not a status string plus optional fields.
expectations: Exhaustive match with assertNever or ts-pattern

evals.prompt: Write the client function that POSTs the new user to /api/users and returns the created record.
evals.expected_output: zod schemas on BOTH directions: request body validated before sending, response parsed before returning; Result-typed errors, no thrown exceptions for expected failures.
expectations: Outbound body goes through safeParse before fetch
Response is parsed before being returned; res.json() is never trusted raw
Expected failures return a typed Result, not throw

evals.prompt: Add a UserService class to hold the cart logic.
evals.expected_output: Suggests a module of pure functions over a readonly Cart type instead; classes reserved for framework demands or genuine resource lifecycles.
expectations: Proposes functions + immutable data rather than a stateful class
Explains the exception cases (framework-required classes) honestly

evals.prompt: This React error boundary has to be a class component, right?
evals.expected_output: Yes - acknowledged as a legitimate class case; no dogmatic rewrite.
expectations: Accepts the framework-mandated class without forcing FP ceremony
